root.label: Trump April 2025 executive order on immigration-related education benefits

events.label: Trump April 2025 executive order on immigration-related education benefits

slots.name: signing date
slots.sentence: Federal lawyers have been targeting policies offering in-state tuition and scholarship benefits to certain undocumented immigrants following an April 2025 executive order signed by President Donald Trump directing the attorney general to identify and stop enforcement of any policies that favor "aliens over any groups of American citizens."
